description:
Read where your organization's transcription request stands, by request_id or by the episode's episode_slug. Free: this is how to wait for a transcription that particle_podcast_request_transcription queued, so poll it every minute or so (a transcription usually takes 5 to 10 minutes) rather than requesting again.

state is queued (waiting its turn), admitted (being transcribed), transcribed (the episode tools now serve its transcript: particle_podcast_get_episode, particle_podcast_find_mentions, particle_podcast_search_transcripts), or failed (failure_reason says why, and the charge is refunded). By episode_slug, your organization's request answers even once the episode is transcribed; for an episode we hold that it never requested, there is no request, and state says where its transcript stands.

episode_slug.description: The episode whose request to read: its episode_slug. Pass this or request_id.

request_id.description: The request's request_id, as particle_podcast_request_transcription returned it. Pass this or episode_slug.

name: particle_podcast_get_transcription_request
title: Particle Podcast Get Transcription Request
